name: Serket
description: A self-sustaining bruiser-summoner who burrows underground to dive the farthest enemy, summons 3 scorpions that inherit her full stats, and converts their deaths into AoE explosions with ATK-Down. Her underground survival mechanic permanently increases her max HP on first threshold, making her tankier the longer a fight lasts.

skills.name: Sand Shadow Scorpions
skills.description: Serket burrows underground and summons 3 scorpions around herself. The scorpions inherit 100% of Serket's base stats but take increased damage, persisting for a duration.

upgrades.level4: Summoned scorpions can also use the Underground Pierce skill.

skills.name: Underground Pierce
skills.description: Serket locks onto the farthest enemy, burrows underground and digs a tunnel toward them, dealing damage to enemies along the path. Upon emerging from the ground, knocks down surrounding enemies.

upgrades.level3: Gains a shield upon emerging from the ground.

skills.name: Scorpion Toxic Burst
skills.description: When summoned scorpions die or disappear, they explode, dealing damage to enemies within a radius and reducing their attack power for a duration.

skills.name: Underground Regeneration
skills.description: While Serket is burrowed underground, she recovers HP every second. When Serket's HP first drops below a percentage of her max HP, she immediately burrows underground for a duration and permanently increases her max HP by a percentage.

upgrades.level2: HP recovered per second while underground increased.
upgrades.level3: Permanent max HP increase when first burrowing below the threshold increased.
upgrades.level4: HP recovered per second while underground increased again.

relic.name: Toxic Miasma Domain
relic.description: Serket deals damage to surrounding enemies every second.

upgrades.level2: When receiving damage exceeding a percentage of her max HP, she becomes immune to that hit and takes reduced damage for the following duration. Triggers at most once every 12 seconds.
upgrades.level3: Each summoned scorpion also deals damage to surrounding enemies every second.
upgrades.level4: When each summoned scorpion receives damage exceeding a percentage of its max HP, it becomes immune to that hit and takes reduced damage for a duration. Triggers at most once every 12 seconds.
